entries.title: Starting point: couch-tv
entries.summary: Asher’s tvOS begins from couch-tv, an open-source home screen, phone remote and bridge for Google TV, set up for the TCL TV.
details: The home screen runs on the TV; a small program on the PC (the bridge) connects the phone remote to it.
Credit to the original project stays in About > Open-source licences.

entries.title: Smoother on the TV
entries.summary: Moving around the home screen got lighter and steadier.
details: Removed the endless focus sway animation.
The Night glass uses a flat tint instead of live blur, which was slowing the TV down.

entries.title: Settings on the TV
entries.summary: A Settings screen on the TV itself, so changes don’t need the phone.
details: Look, clock, temperature unit, date style, scene length, dock size and top buttons.
The country can now be set in the TV config.

entries.title: Restart and reboot from Settings
entries.summary: Restart just the home screen, or reboot the whole TV, from Settings or from the phone’s TV sheet.
details: Rebooting asks you to press OK twice so it can’t happen by accident.

entries.title: Wake-on-LAN is more reliable
entries.summary: Waking the TV from the phone now works more often.
details: Sends the wake signal in several ways and keeps count of what was sent.

entries.title: Back up and restore
entries.summary: Save your TV settings and restore the latest backup from Settings.
details: Backups are saved on the PC.

entries.title: Ask Claude on the TV
entries.summary: Ask a question from the TV and get an answer on screen.

entries.title: iPhone launch screens
entries.summary: The phone remote opens with a proper launch screen when added to an iPhone’s Home Screen.

entries.title: Ask is a conversation
entries.summary: Ask on the phone now works like a chat, and Claude can look things up and act instead of only answering.
details: Chat-style Ask on the phone.
TV brand guide added so the look stays consistent.

entries.title: Ask chat stays open
entries.summary: The Ask chat no longer closes by itself after an answer.

entries.title: Settings PIN
entries.summary: Lock Settings with a 4-digit PIN so nobody changes things by accident.
details: Forgot it? Run reset-pin.cmd on the PC.

entries.title: Apps sort themselves
entries.summary: Choose how apps are ordered: Smart, Most used, Recent, A–Z, Category or My order.
details: Smart puts streaming apps first.

entries.title: Ask knows the weather and the web
entries.summary: Ask can check the weather and search or read web pages, and control the TV, but cannot change files on the PC.

entries.title: About screen
entries.summary: A tidy About page with the version and credits.

entries.title: Picture and Game buttons
entries.summary: Quick buttons open the TV’s own Picture settings and Game bar.
details: The TV doesn’t let apps change the picture mode directly, so these open its own pages.

entries.title: Phone remote redesign and motion pass
entries.summary: The phone remote was redesigned (Remote, Watch, Ask and TV tabs) and movement was made smoother.
details: Live blur removed from the TV home screen for speed.

entries.title: Web apps (Vidbox)
entries.summary: Websites can be added as apps. Vidbox is the first, with pop-ups blocked and ad and adult sites filtered.
details: Opens full screen in the app’s own browser.
The block list is editable; no list is perfect.

entries.title: Boot screen and skeleton loaders
entries.summary: A start-up screen while the home screen loads, and soft placeholders while content is on its way.
details: Shows “Using offline copy” if the PC bridge isn’t reachable.

entries.title: Settings change things live
entries.summary: Toggle a setting and the screen behind the panel updates immediately, with no reload.

entries.title: Springy motion everywhere
entries.summary: Panels, menus and re-ordered apps now open, close and move with Apple-style springs.

entries.title: Debug page and Developer mode
entries.summary: A hidden page for checking the TV’s health, opened by pressing OK seven times on the version in About.
details: Live frame rate, diagnostics, console and errors.
“Send diagnostics” saves a file on the PC.
Developer mode adds extra Settings and switches off after every restart.

entries.title: Night scenes only
entries.summary: Classic, the Look button and Auto Night were removed so the TV keeps one polished look.

entries.title: About shows less
entries.summary: About now shows just the name, version and a small licences line.

entries.title: Old launcher archived, project file added
entries.summary: The earlier launcher is stored away, and PROJECT.md became the one living file that explains the whole project.

entries.title: Vidbox is easier to use
entries.summary: Vidbox can now be used with the remote instead of a mouse.
details: D-pad moves between buttons; hold OK for a free pointer.
A toolbar with Back, Reload, zoom and a smooth mode.
An on-TV keyboard.

entries.title: Type on the phone into web pages
entries.summary: Typing on the phone remote now goes straight into a website’s search box on the TV.

entries.title: Home details removed from public files
entries.summary: The home IP address and city were scrubbed from the install page and sample data.

entries.title: The TV no longer wakes itself into Prime Video
entries.summary: After turning the TV off it sometimes switched back on into Prime Video. That no longer happens.
details: Cause: Prime Video’s leftover process was restarted by Android in standby and asked the screen to turn on.
Fix: Home is brought to the front when the screen turns off, and the bridge presses Home before power-off.
The Debug page has a screen on/off log.

entries.title: Branding settled
entries.summary: The app says Asher’s tvOS everywhere; GitHub files use the Waike name.

entries.title: UI audit: one look everywhere
entries.summary: Colours, text sizes, panels and buttons now come from one shared set of design values.
details: Phone remote: clearer Ask tab, bigger touch targets, better contrast.
Native screens (web app toolbar, keyboard, Blocked page) match the TV’s look.

entries.title: Dev log
entries.summary: This page. A dated history of everything that changed, on the TV in Settings and on the phone.

entries.title: Streaming Vidbox from the PC: groundwork
entries.summary: Moonlight is now on the TV and a one-click Sunshine installer is ready on the PC. A real video converter (ffmpeg) is installed for wallpapers.

entries.title: Phone touchpad and stream tiles for the PC
entries.summary: Your phone can now be a touchpad and keyboard for the computer while Vidbox streams to the TV, and the TV gets Vidbox on PC and PC Desktop tiles.
details: Phone: More controls > Computer > Open touchpad (move, tap, right-click, scroll, hold to drag, type, arrow keys, play/pause, fullscreen)
Safe by design: only the home network, only while a stream runs or PC mode is switched on, no Windows key or Alt+F4
If the PC isn't streaming, the Vidbox tile opens the site in the TV's own browser instead

entries.title: Streaming parked, Vidbox tile removed
entries.summary: The PC streaming controls and the Vidbox tile are hidden for now. Everything is saved in the archive and can come back with one setting.

entries.title: AirPods parked
entries.summary: AirPods is switched off and archived. Nothing was deleted.
details: The AirPods pop-up and Bluetooth audio page did not work well enough, so they are off.
The code stays in the project; a single build switch brings it back (steps are in the archive).
The phone no longer shows the Bluetooth audio button.

entries.title: Phone TV menu layout
entries.summary: The Dev log panel no longer draws over the TV menu on the phone.

entries.title: Remote app buttons switched back on
entries.summary: The four remote app buttons were blocked twice. Both blocks are lifted.
details: Android's accessibility master switch was off, so the key helper never ran. It now switches itself on.
TCL's own app-start control was refusing to start the helper. That permission is now allowed for our launcher.
Still needs one real press of each button to confirm.

board.title: Remote app buttons (Netflix, Prime, YouTube, Apple TV)
board.summary: Fixed twice, still needs one real press. Tell Asher to test.
details: The buttons were dead because the TV's own button handler points at a Google launcher that is switched off.
A small helper now catches the four keys. It needed Android's accessibility switch AND TCL's app-start permission, both now on.
If a button still does nothing, say which one.

board.title: Wallpaper Engine videos
board.summary: Works a little, but buggy. Needs a lot of work.
details: Videos play on the TV, muted. Other kinds show as a still picture.
A 720p option is ready if the TV runs warm.

board.title: Startup animation
board.summary: Works well. Some polish later.
details: Plays when the TV starts and wakes.

board.title: Phone remote layout
board.summary: Works. Could be tidier and better organized.
details: A full overlap check found and fixed one real bug (Dev log over the TV menu).
Next: group and lay out the screens more cleanly.

board.title: TV messages
board.summary: Popups and the Messages list on the TV. Working.
details: Popups stay until OK is pressed.
History is in Settings > Messages and on the phone.

board.title: Dev log
board.summary: Dated history on the TV and the phone, with this Status page.

board.title: Smooth TV
board.summary: Home screen is smooth (median frame 6 ms).
details: The PC prepares the pages so the TV loads less.

board.title: TV no longer wakes into Prime Video
board.summary: Fixed and confirmed.

board.title: iPhone remote connection
board.summary: Works. Layout polish still wanted.

board.title: Offline copy of the TV app
board.summary: Rebuilt and installed with every batch.

board.title: Feature switches
board.summary: Being built: one place to turn parts of the TV and phone on or off.

board.title: Message banner over apps
board.summary: Being built: messages appear over any app, not only Home.

board.title: Faster pictures
board.summary: Being wired in: the PC shrinks big pictures before the TV loads them.

board.title: Profiles
board.summary: Butlers and Asher, kid and guest flags, a home screen for each. After other things are straight.

board.title: Watch history import
board.summary: Bring Netflix and YouTube history into Keep watching.

board.title: Screensaver
board.summary: Wallpaper Engine background (or the plain one) with a big clock, the date and more. To discuss.

board.title: Picture and Game buttons in the top row
board.summary: On hold.

board.title: Setup only Asher can do
board.summary: Folder rename, Cox router and fixed addresses, Brave Search key, iPhone home-screen icon.

board.title: Vidbox streaming from the PC
board.summary: Works, hidden. Saved in the archive.
details: Resume steps are in the archive README.

board.title: AirPods pop-up
board.summary: Did not work well enough, switched off and archived.
